svg.title: The news desk, ten to ten
svg.desc: A newsroom desk with a headline log of eighty-one entries, a ward map with six streets ringed, a resident's letter and a sections board.

g.text: The news desk, ten to ten
Twelve things to find. Two of them are the same ward and one of them is not named.
the ward map, six streets ringed
the style guide, open at DATELINES
the tally chart, in two colours
Priya - eleven years of defending the practice
the letter-writer - 31 years in the ward
the photograph of the main street
the six streets, ringed in red
the window, with the ward in it
